reason: Add a trusted GitHub Actions lane dedicated to user-owned Projects v2 using the founder-vaulted classic PAT while preserving the existing PENTA_PM_GITHUB_TOKEN and repository-native PentaPM lanes.

changes.reason: Run trusted Projects-v2 reconciliation with PENTA_PM_GITHUB_CLASSIC_TOKEN, require provider success, and upload immutable-style evidence without exposing the token to pull-request candidate execution.

exclusions: PENTA_PM_GITHUB_TOKEN is not rotated, replaced, deleted, or superseded.
No raw GitHub token is committed, logged, or projected into repository state.
The classic token lane executes only on trusted main, trusted workflow completion, schedule, or explicit workflow dispatch; it does not execute candidate PR code.
No merge, D3, certification, or provider authority is manufactured; Projects-v2 success must be returned by GitHub and recorded in the PentaPM receipt.
